pages.text: Upon consumption, grants the eater:$(br)$(li)At full health, increases base attack damage by 100%; the bonus scales up as health decreases, reaching a 500% base attack damage increase at 1 HP$(li)Permanent 37% dodge chance$(li)Immune to one fatal damage instance; after immunity triggers, health cap is locked to 1 and self-healing is disabled$(li)Effect lasts 10 minutes; if no mobs hostile to the eater remain when the effect ends, all bonuses and the healing disable are removed
Using the stone sword, flesh and blood, and the heads of enemies as guidance, one can find the Lord's slaughter.$(br)$(br)I did not come to bring peace to the earth, but a sword. — Matthew
